text:
ana: Quick announcement: we're opening a limited pilot for the Private appliance 2.5 build with focused FedRAMP-readiness and FIPS support. Pilot signups start Mon 09:00 PT. Please read the details and flag if you need to be on the pilot.

jia: Pilot window = 2 weeks; GA goal = 2026-04-30. Pilot capacity small (10-15 customers). Signup form: https://confluence.redwood/internal/private/pilot-signup (internal).

sam: Security summary: v2.5 includes optional FIPS-validated crypto path, support for FIPS-mode KMS endpoints, and HSM integration for customers that require certified key storage. Air-gapped installer available; note key-rotation is manual for air-gapped installs.

oliver: Ops plan: canary rollout pattern: 10% -> 40% -> full pilot with health windows. Oncall for pilot: @oliver primary, @jia backup. Runbook: /runbooks/private-2.5-pilot.md.

maria: CS note: we'll offer 6 hours of migration assistance per pilot customer. CSMs, collect customer infra details up front (KMS type, network posture, acceptance window).

ryan: Sales asking for contract language around "FedRAMP-ready" vs "FedRAMP authorization in progress". Legal to draft safe phrasing. Also collecting a short FAQ for pre-sales.

laura: Legal: will produce an addendum template and compliance FAQ. Reminder: we cannot claim FedRAMP authorization yet, only readiness artifacts. ETA 3 business days.

deploy-bot: "note: private-2.5-pilot-checklist created by jia at 2026-03-25T14:00Z"

jia: Airgap install example for docs:

```bash
./rwinf-airgap-install --bundle /tmp/rwinf-2.5-bundle.tar.gz \
  --kms-provider external \
  --kms-endpoint https://kms.customer.example \
  --accept-eula
```

sam: EU customers: data residency toggle will be added in a follow-up patch. For pilot, recommend local deploy targets and validate control-plane routing.

oliver: Short ops checklist: snapshot DB, disable autoscaling during initial canary period, enable debug logging for first 12h, collect perf histograms every 5m.

maria: Can we get two engineers assigned for week-1 migrations? @eng-managers please advise.

ryan: Flagging strategic customers that requested FIPS/FedRAMP options. CC @sam @laura for customer briefings.

laura: Will include template security language for sales and a pointer to artifacts in the compliance drive.

ana: Ops update: legacy non-VPC appliance will be deprecated in 6 months; we'll provide migration tooling and an opt-in extended support path. Customers must be notified.

sam: Action item: create a short customer-facing changelog listing crypto primitives, supported KMS integrations, and HSM partners.

ana: Scheduling an internal technical walkthrough next Wed 10:00 PT  invite out after this thread. Please RSVP if you want the deep-dive.

maria: RSVP'd. CSMs will prepare top-5 customer questions and a migration checklist.

oliver: Can we rehearse the canary runbook Tue 08:00 PT? I'll coordinate.

deploy-bot: "scheduled: private-2.5-pilot-kickoff 2026-03-31T16:00Z"

ana: Thanks team  big step for Private. If you're not in the pilot please react with :eyes: and we'll share the recording and notes.
